title: QuestCategories catalog
description: Chooses which Pip-Boy quest tab (MAIN, SIDE, MISC, LEADS or EVENTS) each quest is listed in.
x-help:
The Pip-Boy DATA page has five quest tabs: MAIN, SIDE, MISC, LEADS and EVENTS. Tales puts every loaded quest in a tab by its quest type, so quests from the base game, DLC and other mods already land somewhere sensible, and any quest with no match ends up in MISC.

Add a row here to force one quest into a different tab. The converted Fallout 76 quests are already placed by the conversion. The EVENTS tab is also filled from Tales' own list of public events, which wins over this catalog.
